summary: No agent-mode design anti-patterns found. Agent prompts are objective-focused rather than rigidly procedural. Handoff data is passed via lightweight env vars (not baked-in file content). Structured JSON outputs go to machine-consumed paths (.egg-state/agent-outputs/), not humans. File access restrictions are sandbox-enforced via FileAccessPattern and gateway, not just prompt-level. No post-processing pipelines parsing agent output.
